Changes: Fixed Pulsebar reporting its version as 1.0.0, which made the update checker announce an update even on the latest release and hid the changelog for new versions.
Fixed Run at Startup not launching Pulsebar after a reboot.
Fixed the changelog window showing the original project's version history.
Tightened the spacing above the sidebar clock.
Added a GitHub Releases update checker.
Fixed the installer's post-install launch failing with an elevation error.
Forked from Sidebar Diagnostics and rebranded as Pulsebar.
Migrated the project to .NET 10 and the LibreHardwareMonitor NuGet package.
Reskinned the sidebar with a dark theme: translucent panel, rounded pill-style load bars, refreshed typography, a bigger clock, and section dividers.
Added type-aware load bar severity coloring (drives use space-based thresholds; GPU never shows red).
Rebuilt the Settings window with a dark-themed General, Appearance, Display, Advanced, Hotkeys, and Monitors layout.
Rebuilt the Monitors tab as collapsible cards.
Added detection of a missing PawnIO driver with a prompt to install it from Settings.
Added a Windows installer (Inno Setup) built and published through the release workflow.
